details: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 3d16733f. The release decodes channels one at a time and reports undecodable slots instead of failing the whole list, lets bug reports attach the radio image, enables the experimental TK-350 write path and decodes/preserves its CTCSS tones, adds the UV-5RM Pro plain-PROGRAM synchronization fallback, and gives the Find Repeaters results list its own scroll bar. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 257 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 693 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.78 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the per-channel decode, image-report, TK-350, UV-5RM Pro, and Repeater UI changes and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.78.
